system.description:
This weapon's [Ranged Attack] will prevent any character who takes 1 or more HP damage from entering the [Hidden] state. This effect lasts until the end of the scene. A magical bow that rings with the clear sound of a bell when drawn. The sound of the bell continues to echo even after the arrow is fired, revealing the location of those who are struck.

Wind-Singing Bell [Core Material] (80G) + Short Bow (150G) + Far-Hearing Earring (40G) + Firefly Gem (40G) + [Magic Catalyst 5] (40G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (150G)
